result:
I would make it impossible for people to genuinely misunderstand one another’s suffering.

Not to force agreement, not to erase disagreement, but so that whenever someone causes harm, they can at least clearly feel the human reality of the person affected by it. I think much of the world’s cruelty comes from abstraction: distance, labels, denial, and the ability to treat other people like concepts instead of lived beings.

If that one thing changed, a lot of other things would probably follow.
